subject: Weathered hands of an elderly Tamil woman with glass bangles and a thin gold ring, pinching rice flour between her thumb and forefinger to lay down crisp white kolam strokes over Athangudi tiles

setting.place: Central open-air pillared courtyard (valavu) of a heritage Chettinad mansion in Kanadukathan, featuring hand-carved Burma teak wooden pillars and glazed Athangudi floral floor tiles

camera.lens: 85mm f/1.8 macro portrait lens, shallow depth of field
camera.angle: Low eye-level angle focusing on weathered hands and ground

lighting: Warm low-angle amber sunlight streaming through carved timber eaves, casting long architectural shadows and highlighting dust motes across the courtyard
style: Hyper-realistic cultural documentary photography, authentic textures, filmic depth of field
